title: Completing an already-completed todo should be an error
probes: TDD discipline on a change small enough that skipping the red step is tempting. The commit history should show the failing test before the fix.
description:
As a todo user I want to be told when a command did nothing so that I do not think I changed something I did not.

`complete` currently maps over the list and sets `done: true`, so completing an already-completed todo succeeds silently and reports success. It should instead fail the same way an unknown id does, with a message naming the id and saying it is already complete.

Unknown ids must keep their current error exactly as it is.
